BOUNDARY: pattern_cycle is not producible (mutual and self-lineage cycles cannot be submitted or activated; the closest producible shape is classified nested_pattern_not_active). The literal-tree bounds are enforced by the table CHECK cms_pattern_versions_block_tree_valid, so only the expanded bounds can be stored over the limit.

Unproven sub-branches (BOUNDARY): (1) entry deletion/tombstone: no command exists. cms_content_entries.lifecycle admits archived, deletion_pending and held (supabase/migrations/20260926090000_cms_entry_revision_authority.sql:33-34; BE03b 1964, 1980, 2005) but no platform_api or platform_private function writes it (catalog scan in supabase/tests/phase_02_slice_12_gaps_db9b_deletion.sql, BOUNDARY facts), and BE03b 1891 `entry_unavailable` is the reader side only; the writer belongs to a later shard and no spec in BE03b or BE03c defines it. (2) composition-source deletion: composition-instance rows are append-only (DELETE and UPDATE are refused, proved in the same file); the only tombstone is the retired row CMS-03C-15 accept appends for a removed root (supabase/migrations/20261014140600_cms_apply_pattern_update.sql:241), covered by phase_02_slice_12_dec193_consumers and phase_02_slice_12_pattern_updates*.
